families.overallRead: The Mothra row reads correctly as a four-wing bilateral moth family — the old cyan-glowing-lizard bug is genuinely gone, blue/gold sits as an accent over a furred body, and the per-forewing eyespots carry the brand. But within-row escalation has almost entirely collapsed: gxk and supernova render as plain recolors of gvm. The single root cause is a plumbing gap — drawMothThorax (archetypes.js L584) and drawFlyerHead (L606) are both called WITHOUT the shape arg, so every shape{} escalation knob that the data already declares (joints:true on gxk/supernova, godrays:true on supernova) is dead: grep confirms s.joints is consumed ONLY by buildMecha (L1105), and 'godray'/'wingLevel'/'eyespotIris' have zero consumers anywhere. Three cross-cutting render bugs compound it: (1) the two swept-back antennae — a named mustHaveForBlindID and the head-crown silhouette cue — are stroked in pal.skinDark (taupe/bronze/soft-gold) at lineWidth 1.8 over a paler head on ALL three forms, so they vanish; the palette already carries a white-ish skinLight for each form, so this is a one-line shared fix. (2) The forewing tipY is hard-coded -BH*0.92 in drawMothWing (L645) for all three, so supernova's 'level descending-angel' pose can't exist. (3) The WH span is capped at 50px (L577), and supernova's wingSpan 3.3 computes ~51.7 → clipped to 50, INVERTING the ladder so the form that should be widest gains the least. Highest-leverage path: thread shape into the two helpers, fix the shared antenna color, then layer the per-form escalations (gxk blue joint-spots + thicker body; supernova god-rays + level pose + gold eyespot iris + aura + uncapped span). One correction to the critiques: fxMotes:'pink' is NOT a wrong-hue leak — MOTE_FX.pink draws in pal.plateGlow, which is form-correct (cyan for gvm/gxk, gold for supernova), so leave fxMotes alone (drop that fix). Bake budget respected throughout: flat low-alpha triangles + one radial aura, deterministic, no shadowBlur/filter/composite.

families.family: King Ghidorah (hydra, 3 heads) — row 3: ghidorah, king_ghidorah, mecha_ghidorah, grand_king, void_ghidorah
families.overallRead: The family read ("three necks + two wings") survives on every form and the 5-form color ladder is legible (gold trio / silver-cyborg / dark-cyan void), but the family is bottlenecked by three SHARED-helper defects that flatten 4 of 5 forms into near-identical "gold three-headed peacock" silhouettes: (1) drawBatWing renders the wings as flat near-horizontal radiating fan-blades (wrist on the body, thin vertical sliver dominated by spar strokes) rather than drooping bat-membranes, so the upper silhouette reads as a peacock-tail spread on all forms; (2) drawHydraHeads draws the three necks coplanar with no z-reorder, so the #1 MonsterVerse cue (center neck thrust FORWARD and overlapping) is absent and all gold tiers look symmetric; (3) drawGhidorahHead's horn crown is a single swept-prong primitive shared by every form, so the load-bearing per-tier horn signatures (T1 soft-curved vs T2 rigid-straight rack vs T4 forked-antler) do not differentiate at 40px. On top of that, two per-form structural misses dominate: void_ghidorah is drawn ON a full winged/legged/tailed torso (its named FAILURE MODE — "dark winged Ghidorah") instead of bodiless necks from a portal, and mecha_ghidorah's silver plating is a translucent ~0.36-alpha grey wash instead of opaque armor. Highest-leverage path: fix the three shared helpers FIRST (they lift all five forms at once), then gate void's body off, then the per-form horn overrides. The gold/eye palette is on-spec with NO purple-beam regression — preserve it.

forms.currentRead: A fat upright golden egg-body with a single pair of flat radiating fan-blades sticking straight out sideways (reads as a peacock tail, not bat-wings), topped by three thin stalks each ending in a tiny bird head with a small crow-beak and an up-forward crest. Three-neck + two-wing family read holds and the gold/golden-eye palette is correct (no purple-beam bug), but it reads 'generic gold 3-head dragon / gold peacock,' not specifically MonsterVerse Ichi: the center neck is NOT thrust forward, the crown reads as a forward bird-crest not a back-swept dragon rake, and the 'wings' are flat spokes.

families.family: Rodan (flyer / pteranodon) — row 4: rodan (Showa t1), rodan_mv (MonsterVerse Fire Demon t2), rodan_fire (Heisei Fire Rodan t3)
families.overallRead:
Adjudicating row 4 of the live composite against the spec confirms the headline finding from all three lenses AND surfaces two render-level problems the per-lens critiques under-weighted. The entire pteranodon HEAD path is byte-identical across all three forms: drawCrestHorns (archetypes.js:530) is defined but NEVER called, and drawChestSpikes / goldCrest / a black-beak override simply do not exist. So the spec's load-bearing differentiators — straight vs V-split crest (t1-vs-t2), the spiky sternum (all three), Fire Rodan's gold crest + gold chest spines + BLACK beak (t3-vs-t2, the single most distinctive Fire-Rodan cue) — are ALL unrendered. The three forms separate ONLY by body hue + scallop count + fissures + fireRim.

Two things the live render makes obvious that the lens critiques softened: (1) THE DOMINANT VISUAL on t2/t3 is not a wing — it is a vertical TREE of magma cracks running straight down past the bottom of the canvas, with the wings hanging below the body as droopy lobes that read as roots. The cause is that drawFissures (archetypes.js:96) was authored for the wyrm's tall vertical torso (angle ~vertical, sy spanning -0.74..-0.22 BH, len up to 0.34 BH) and is reused verbatim on the flyer's slim horizontal lozenge (cy=-0.55 BH, half-height only 0.15 BH) — so the cracks spill far below the body and stack into a magma trunk. This single artifact does more damage to the 'flat fire-glider' read than the missing crest does, and no lens named it as the primary fix. (2) At front-facing (base 0, lean=0) the wing has no horizontal lean to flatten it, so drawPteranoWing's trailing-edge drop (+BH*0.10) makes both wings hang as a hunched bat/owl skirt rather than a near-horizontal blade — the body half-width (BW*0.72) roughly equals the wing half-span (capped at 50px), so the wings do NOT dwarf the body as the family spec demands.

The fix set is therefore: (A) constrain drawFissures to the flyer body band so the magma stays ON the body (kills the trunk) — highest single-edit leverage for t2/t3; (B) one shared wiring of drawCrestHorns into drawFlyerHead with per-form color (straight bone-tan t1 / vsplit rock t2 / vsplit gold t3) — restores the top vertex of the WING+CREST+BEAK triangle and the t1/t2/t3 crest divergence in one edit; (C) lengthen+droop the beak and add a beakColor override so Fire Rodan gets its black beak; (D) narrow the body lozenge + flatten the wing trailing edge so the wings dominate; (E) add drawChestSpikes (bone-tan t1 / rock t2 / gold t3). I dropped the buildFlyer self-illum rim port (low blind-ID leverage vs cost; t2/t3 bodies don't sink once the fissure-trunk is fixed and the body palette already reads hot), the serrated-beak notches and comet-trail (sub-pixel/optional at 40px), and the WH-cap raise is downgraded to a guarded tweak because the widest tip + drips must stay inside x∈[0,150] from anchor 75.

forms.currentRead: A rounded, hunched brown owl/bat blob: a broad mahogany lozenge body roughly as wide as the wing half-span, with wings sweeping DOWN into droopy lobes that hang below the body (cloaked/skirted read, not a flat glider). The head is a small fused lump with NO crest point and NO horns breaking the skyline; the beak is a tiny near-horizontal nub. Amber eye, flameless brown palette correct. forms.currentRead: The bulkiest silhouette (bulk 1.12, correct for 'heaviest over-built mecha'), gold-tan, with a distinct backpack mass behind the upper back (the 'Super' add — delivered) and a giant oversized front lead dorsal fin. Reads as 'big gold robot with a backpack and one huge front fin.' BUT the head is the plain helmet wedge — IDENTICAL to mecha_2's recolored gold — so the #1 Kiryu tell is missing; box panels + no skull blade + no wiring mean at iso it collapses toward 'a bulky gold mecha_2,' separated only by backpack-vs-pod. The all-warm gold with no cool/black contrast also drifts toward 'golden organic kaiju.'

topChanges.change: Add the forehead-to-nape SKULL BLADE (Kiryu's instant head identifier). New shape flag headBlade:true (config.js 272); in drawMechHead after the skull fill (~line 1437) draw a raised ridge along the skull top — a thin filled triangle/quad from hlx (forehead) to hlx+hw*0.9 (nape), height ≈BH*0.03 (≥2px), fill pal.skinLight with a rimCol(0.6) top edge. Also set antennae:0 on super_mecha (the non-canonical antennae compete with the blade for the head skyline).
topChanges.target: shape.headBlade + shape.antennae:0; new ridge in drawMechHead
topChanges.expectedEffect: Biases the head silhouette to read 'bladed Kiryu' not 'helmet mecha_2' — restores the #1 must-have and makes the head (not antennae) the differentiator from the blue tier.
topChanges.regressionRisk: Low — gated on headBlade which only super_mecha sets; the mecha_ghidorah cyborg head (helmet, no headBlade) and mecha_2 are unchanged.

topChanges.change: Add exposed THICK BLACK WIRING to anchor the gold as METAL. New shape flag wiring:true (config.js 272); in buildMecha/drawMechHead draw 2-3 thick dark strokes (lineWidth ≈ BH*0.02, color '#1a1a1a') at the neck-to-shoulder and hip joints.
topChanges.expectedEffect: The cheapest, highest-identity way to break the 'golden organic kaiju' misread — black-cable-vs-gold contrast forces the cyborg-on-a-skeleton read the spec flags as the live failure mode.
topChanges.regressionRisk: Low — wiring-gated, super_mecha-only. Keep strokes at the joints, not a full cable field (noise at iso).

topChanges.change: Optional: curved organic muscle-line seams. New shape flag organicSeams:true (config.js 272); in drawMechPanels, when set, replace the straight chest/belly seams with 2-3 quadraticCurveTo seams following the torso taper and soften the rect fills. Also trim the lead fin (drawMechSpines size*=1.7 → ~1.5 when backpack present) so the backpack owns the rear-upper skyline.
topChanges.target: shape.organicSeams; curved-seam branch in drawMechPanels + leadFin trim in drawMechSpines
topChanges.expectedEffect: Shifts the body read from 'hard-box tank' toward 'armored anatomy' (the Kiryu must-have) and stops the backpack and giant lead fin fighting for the upper-back mass.
topChanges.regressionRisk: Medium — drawMechPanels is shared by all four; STRICTLY gate on organicSeams so mecha_1/2/3 keep box panels. Lower priority than headBlade+wiring, which do more for the ID; drop first if it threatens a sibling.

sharedHelperChanges.change: Add an opts.selfIllum && pal.rimGlow path: after the torso fill, re-stroke the torso path with pal.rimGlow (lineWidth 2.5, alpha 0.5). Requires threading pal + selfIllum through torsoOpts in buildMecha (currently torsoOpts carries only {joints, leanPose}). Separately, gate a leanPose forward-shear on the top edge (+BW*0.10 over the waist) behind the existing opts.leanPose.
sharedHelperChanges.rationale: The red self-illum rim is mecha_3's mandatory night-visibility fix and the family's single biggest failure; the shear makes mecha_3's lean actually read.
sharedHelperChanges.regressionRisk: Shared by all four mecha. Both additions are flag-gated (selfIllum / leanPose) and only mecha_3 sets them today, so mecha_1/2/super stay byte-identical. The mecha_ghidorah cyborg path does NOT call drawMechTorso, so the hydra is untouched. rimGlow is a NEW red token — do not route it through rimCol() (warm-white).

sharedHelperChanges.change: Two gated branches: (a) gapGlow:true → seam lineWidth ≥2.2 + 2-3 short hot #ff2020/#ff6a4a chest/back segments, drop the per-panel spread elsewhere (mecha_3); (b) organicSeams:true → curved quadratic chest/belly seams replacing the straight ones (super_mecha).
sharedHelperChanges.rationale: gapGlow delivers mecha_3's 'red bleeding through black' must-have AND its anti-organic-misread disambiguator; organicSeams delivers super_mecha's muscle-line armor must-have.
sharedHelperChanges.regressionRisk: HIGHEST cross-form surface in the plan — drawMechPanels fills the box panels/seams/rivets for ALL four mecha. Both branches MUST be strictly flag-gated so mecha_1 chrome and mecha_2 gunmetal box panels render unchanged. drawMechPanels is NOT used by the hydra cyborg, so no ghidorah regression.

sharedHelperChanges.change: Gate three opt-in adds: (1) opts.cybanek → narrow the visor rect to ~hw*0.40 centered so it stops bridging the two temple orbs, + bump orb radius floor to max(2.6,hw*0.15), + optional orbCol '#e0202a'; (2) opts.headBlade → raised forehead-to-nape ridge after the skull fill; (3) opts.missilePods is NOT added here (handled in buildMecha if pursued).
sharedHelperChanges.rationale: Fixes mecha_1's merged orb/visor red (its #1 identifier) and adds super_mecha's skull blade (its #1 identifier).
sharedHelperChanges.regressionRisk: CRITICAL caller note — drawMechHead is also called by the mecha_ghidorah cyborg CENTER head (buildHydra line 1061, headStyle:'helmet', no cybanek/headBlade opts) with a cyberPal that has no rimGlow. All three adds default off, so the hydra cyborg, mecha_2 helmet, and mecha_3 ghidorah head are byte-identical. Verify nothing reads opts.cybanek/headBlade unconditionally.

implementationOrder: mecha_3 red self-illumination rim (config rimGlow + selfIllum, thread pal through torsoOpts, re-stroke in drawMechTorso) — fixes the single biggest blind-ID failure: the near-black body sinking into the night sky
mecha_3 concentrated gap-glow (gapGlow flag + gated drawMechPanels branch: ≥2.2px hot chest/back seams, drop the body-wide red wash) — delivers 'red through black' and kills the burning-wyrm misread
mecha_1 separate orb-red from visor-red (narrow cybanek visor to hw*0.40) + radius floor bump — makes the two Cybanek temple domes read as the #1 Showa identifier instead of one red bar
super_mecha skull blade (headBlade flag + ridge in drawMechHead) + antennae:0 — restores Kiryu's instant head tell so it stops reading as a gold mecha_2
mecha_1 bulbous shoulder caps (roundShoulders flag in buildMecha) + bulk 0.95→~1.0 — delivers the crudest-bulbous-robot silhouette must-have
super_mecha black wiring (wiring flag, dark joint strokes) — cheap high-identity break of the golden-organic-kaiju misread
mecha_2 palette desaturation to gunmetal + push the shoulder pod further outward — finish-nuance + strengthen the one Heisei silhouette cue
mecha_3 lean (bulk→0.9 + leanPose forward-shear in drawMechTorso) — separates its outline from 'dark mecha_2'
super_mecha organic curved seams (organicSeams flag in drawMechPanels) + lead-fin trim — armored-anatomy read; lowest leverage, highest shared-helper risk, drop first if it threatens a sibling
mecha_2 optional far shoulder pod / mecha_3 optional missile pods — secondary silhouette adds, only if iso clutter stays acceptable
